metadata.purpose: Board-family truth for AS-2518-16 solenoid driver. Game-agnostic; used as a base for per-game overlays.
notes: Connector suffix codes (C/B/P) in schematics indicate routing destination (cabinet/backbox/playfield), not distinct board headers.
Board-side headers modeled here: J1P, J2, J3B, J5.
J1P is the board-side playfield connector; there is no bare J1 on this board.
Q1, Q2, Q3, Q16, and Q18 drive multi-drop nets (multiple connector pins on the board share a single transistor output).
Q3 multi-drop: J2-5 and J3B-4 (Knocker).
Q16 multi-drop: J5-8, J2-6, J3B-7.
Q1 multi-drop: J1P-2 and J2-9 (Chime 10).
Q2 multi-drop: J2-4 (unlabeled) and J1P-3 (Saucer).
Q18 multi-drop: J5-3, J2-15, J3B-9 (unused in known games).
Q7 output J2-12 is used as an 'extra chime' in at least one game.
J3B-8 is the high-voltage output feed (HV_OUTPUT) from this board.
All coil/feature names are intentionally omitted here; they belong in game-specific overlays.
Exact mapping of decoder outputs to Q-numbers may vary per schematic; only relative driver roles are important here.
Direct-drive transistors Q15, Q16, Q17, Q18, Q19 are not part of the main BCD decoder path.
Q1 output is shared between J1P-2 and J2-9.
J2-9 is used as 'Chime 10' in at least one game; J1P-2 is unlabeled in reference schematic.
Q2 output is shared between J2-4 (unlabeled) and J1P-3 (Saucer in at least one game).
Q3 output is shared between J2-5 and J3B-4.
J3B-4 is used as the knocker coil output in at least one game.
Q4 output is routed only to J1P-5.
J1P-5 is used as the outhole coil in at least one game.
J2-12 is used as an 'extra chime' in at least one game.
Q15 is a direct-drive transistor to J3B-5 (typically a relay or special coil).
Q16 output is shared between J5-8, J2-6, and J3B-7.
All three endpoints are unlabeled in the reference schematic; usage is game-dependent.
Q18 output is shared between J5-3, J2-15, and J3B-9 on this board.
All three endpoints are unused (N/U) in the reference game; future games may use one or more.
Schematic labels such as J5P-3 and J2C-15 are harness-side references; board-side headers are J5 and J2.
Schematic label 'J2C-8' refers to a cabinet connector; board-side header is J2 pin 8.
Board-side header routing to playfield harness.
Only pins used by driver outputs are listed here.
Board-side header routing primarily to playfield and cabinet connectors via harness.
Only pins used by driver outputs are listed here.
